description: Since 2026-10-03 the float column ALWAYS carries the dilution snapshot's own figure when the snapshot has one: "float" is the measured POINT float (null on a withheld snapshot row), and such a row then carries "floatEstimate" (shares) + "floatEstimateBound" ("point" / "ceiling" / "floor") + "floatEstimateBasis" (the working). RENDERING (2026-10-18): a "point" is the plain number with its basis as the caveat; a "ceiling" / "floor" is a BOUND, not a figure — write "float not stated (at most / at least 7,953,957)", never the bare number and never a "~" / "<=" / ">=" glyph. minFloat / maxFloat and the computed_float sort compare the figure's VALUE (COALESCE of the two), so a bounded row is kept; a row with neither is NOT MEASURED, never 0. 🔴 Never feed floatEstimate into a market cap, a percent-of-float or a short-interest ratio — a bound is not a point. Screen companies by price range, volume, cash runway, float, shares outstanding (each row's `shares_outstanding` is DATED by `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` (stated / checked / none = date not recorded) and a vendor-free `sharesOutstandingSource`; never present the count without its date), market cap, industry, listing exchange (NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX), listing market (market="otc" / "exchange" — the reliable OTC test; the exchange label is inconsistent on OTC rows), float data source, TTM dividend yield and snapshot cash (minCash / maxCash). CASH RUNWAY: a null cash_runway_months carries cashRunwayReason saying why. "estimate_would_be_negative" means the last cash figure rolled forward by the burn rate is below zero today — ESTIMATED exhausted, not a reported zero balance (cashRunwayAsOf is the cash figure's date). Such rows have no months, so maxCashRunway drops them unless includeRunwayExhausted=true. Any other reason, or a null reason, is NOT a runway claim. CASH: estimatedCurrentCash (with estimatedCashAsOf) is the dilution snapshot's cash PROJECTION in USD, present only for snapshot-covered companies — null means NOT MEASURED, never "no cash", and minCash / maxCash can only return covered companies. A company whose filings report cash in another currency has a null estimatedCurrentCash (no FX conversion) and is never matched by minCash / maxCash; its cash_runway_months is still published. Each row also carries listingMarket ("exchange" / "otc", null = unknown). Each row carries dividendYield (trailing-twelve-month cash dividends with an ex-date in the last 365 days / current price, in percent), nextExDate and lastExDate — null means NOT MEASURED or not a payer, never 0%. Sort results by any sortable column. Returns matching companies with key metrics and pagination. Each row carries live trading-halt status (halted/haltCode/haltedAt; false/null when trading normally); pass excludeHalted=true to drop currently-halted tickers from the results.

country.description: Company universe by issuer domicile: "US" (default), "CA" (Canadian companies via their US-OTC/US cross-listings), or "all"

exchange.description: Filter by listing exchange: NASDAQ (every tier), NYSE (includes NYSE Arca), or AMEX (NYSE American). Each matches every spelling of that exchange; names that moved to OTC never match. For OTC use market="otc" instead

excludeHalted.description: When true, exclude tickers with a currently-active trading halt (regulatory or volatility) from the results. Default false — halted rows are included and carry halted/haltCode/haltedAt fields.

includeRunwayExhausted.description: When true, maxCashRunway also returns companies whose estimated cash is already exhausted (cash_runway_months null, cashRunwayReason "estimate_would_be_negative"); they sort first on an ascending runway sort. Default false

industry.description: Filter by company industry (exact match, e.g. "Biotechnology", "Software")

market.description: Listing market: "otc" (OTC Markets) or "exchange" (NASDAQ / NYSE / NYSE American / Arca / Cboe). Companies with no listing record match neither

maxCash.description: Maximum dilution-snapshot cash projection in USD (estimatedCurrentCash). Snapshot-covered companies only — an uncovered company is not measured, not excluded for having cash

maxCashRunway.description: Maximum estimated months of cash remaining

maxDividendYield.description: Maximum TTM dividend yield in percent. Rows with no measured yield never match.

maxMarketCapComputed.description: Maximum market cap in USD (price * shares outstanding)

maxSharesOutstanding.description: Maximum shares outstanding from SEC EDGAR

minCash.description: Minimum dilution-snapshot cash projection in USD (estimatedCurrentCash). Snapshot-covered companies reporting in USD only

minCashRunway.description: Minimum estimated months of cash remaining

minDividendYield.description: Minimum TTM dividend yield in percent (e.g. 3 for 3%). Rows with no measured yield never match.

minMarketCapComputed.description: Minimum market cap in USD (price * shares outstanding)

minSharesOutstanding.description: Minimum shares outstanding from SEC EDGAR

sortBy.description: Column to sort results by (default: volume)
